title: QCLI-539 review follow-ups: create --priority "" still stores an empty string, and the empty-value clear has gaps in create/edit-batch coverage
description: Non-blocking findings from the DEC-183 review of #691 (QCLI-539), kept out of that PR. (1) `task create --priority ""` still stores "": src/cli/main.ts builds the create input directly and never reaches foldEditPatch, so create and edit disagree about an empty value. (2) edit-batch shares the fold and now clears an empty priority; #691 adds one test and a changelog line for it, but the create path and --type are not covered. QCLI-540 files the --type half separately. Related: vocabularyDrift skips "" (src/domain/tasks/vocabulary.ts), so doctor never reports an empty-string value; decide whether a stored empty string is ever expected to be reported. Reproduce against `bun src/cli/main.ts` first.

acceptanceCriteria.text: task create --priority "" behaves the same as task edit --priority "": no empty priority is stored
The decision for an empty value on create is stated in task create help and covered by a test in both directions
Whether doctor should report an already-stored empty string is decided and recorded on this task
